slug: 2025-12-28 Over 1.3 Million Citizens Enrolled on INRIS

facts.fact: The Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security's public relations officer says about 1.3 million citizens have been enrolled on INRIS and over 500,000 births and deaths have been registered, with no period or denominator given.

The Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security speaks for INRIS and for the civil registration and identity management reforms as the government's own, saying that under the previous administration implementation was manual, fragmented and underfunded, with no dedicated funding for birth and death registration in 2019 and 2020.
